Cut 4.0 -> 3.5 on 2026-07-13; was 5.0 pre-06-09. ⚠️ THE ON-CHAIN USDat BUFFER — THE ONLY INSTANTLY-REDEEMABLE SLICE — HAS COLLAPSED TO ~1.8% OF ASSETS ($1.36M of $75.4M, 2026-07-13) FROM ~7% (06-09) AND ~19% (05-20). That is a 10x contraction in the liquid share across two months, so a coordinated exit now depends almost entirely on STRC LIQUIDATION AT THE CUSTODIAN into a still-sub-par market. ⚠️ TVL ALSO CONTRACTED ~28% ($104.5M -> $75.4M), so the buffer shrank as a SHARE of a book that was itself shrinking — both directions adverse. Underlying secondary is a single thin Curve venue at a discount to NAV, and the GATED PRIMARY KEEPS NON-ONBOARDED HOLDERS ON IT. ⚠️ The dashboard axis derives off live MARKET-BASIS 2% depth, isolating depth from the standing discount — which is the Peg axis's job, deliberately.
